function: Learns, with TD3 guided by a large AI model, the AAV's RSMA precoding vectors and message-splitting ratios jointly with task-offloading ratios to minimize communication and computation energy (p. 7).
system: AAV at 100 m with 4 antennas serving 3 single-antenna rescue devices by RSMA downlink, 2 co-channel noncooperative devices, 2.4 GHz, 10 MHz bandwidth; no RIS (p. 9).
method: Deep reinforcement learning, TD3 actor-critic (two hidden layers of 150 neurons) trained online by trial and error, with a large language model proposing actions to speed training (pp. 7-10).
data_channel: Custom simulation: spatially correlated Ricean channel with random LoS phases (Eq. 4), Rayleigh path-loss interference links, 200 m x 200 m area; no dataset or measurements (pp. 5, 9).
test_conditions: Same simulated scenario for training and evaluation (1 AAV, 3 rescuers); bandwidth 8-12 MHz and task size 0.8-1.2 Mbit varied in Fig. 10; no separate test stated (pp. 9-12).
baselines: Learned only: JTORA-DDPG, JTORA-PPO, JTORA-SAC and JTORA-TD3 (same formulation, other DRL algorithms); no non-learned baseline (pp. 10-11).
metrics: Normalized reward and weighted energy consumption (J) versus training steps, and energy versus bandwidth and task size (pp. 11-12).
q1_support: p. 5: "modeled as a spatially correlated Ricean channel with a phase shift" and "Considering path loss and Rayleigh fading" for interference links; custom simulation, no 3GPP model, dataset or measurement is named.
q2_support: p. 11: "energy consumption versus moving steps of rescuers under varying communication bandwidths and task bits"; p. 9 fixes 10 MHz and 1 Mbit for the setup; the paper never says the trained agent is tested on other values without retraining.
q3_support: p. 10: "replacing the TD3 architecture in JTORA-TD3 with soft actor-critic (soft actor–critic (SAC)), DDPG, and proximal policy optimization (PPO)"; Figs. 7-10 (pp. 11-12) show only DRL variants, no non-learned baseline.
q4_support: p. 9: "the LAM’s inference latency increases the total training time" is qualitative; p. 10 gives network sizes but no operation count, parameter count, complexity order or measured runtime of the method.
q5_support: p. 10: "The software environment we utilize is Python 3.10 on Windows 10 22H2"; the paper describes a simulation only, with no code or data link, DOI, or public or measured channel dataset.
notes: Included through the joint clause of above_phy: the TD3 action holds the RSMA precoding vectors and splitting ratios (physical layer) together with the offloading ratios (above PHY), p. 7. Area 6 over 3 because the precoder acts on an aerial AAV downlink and 6 is more specific; reviewer to confirm. The stated network size of 3 inputs and 10 outputs (p. 10) does not match the state and action dimensions of p. 7. LAM sizes 14B, 32B, 70B (pp. 11-12) are a convergence study, not a cost report, so q4 is 0. Rescuer paths come from A*, not from learning (p. 4).
